description: This source file implements the Linux-specific DNS configuration service for Chromium, including reading and parsing system DNS settings, managing watchers for configuration files, and converting system resolver state to internal DNS configuration structures.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::Watcher
classes.description: Linux-specific implementation of DNS configuration file watchers, monitoring changes to system DNS config files and triggering configuration reloads.

classes.name: DnsConfigServiceLinux::ConfigReader
classes.description: Worker class that reads and parses system DNS configuration asynchronously, converting system resolver state into internal DNS configuration.

methods.description: Triggers an immediate DNS configuration reload.

methods.description: Starts watching DNS configuration files for changes.
